# Mavic Brand Marketing Workbench

> Free, open toolkits, workbench templates, AI skills and video templates for brand marketing in the AI era. Writing CC BY 4.0, code MIT. Made by Mavic (mavic.ai).

## Start
- README.md: what this is and how the parts fit together
- AGENTS.md: guide for AI assistants
- LICENSE: CC BY 4.0 for writing, MIT for code; the Mavic name and logo are not licensed

## Toolkits
- toolkits/02-brand-voice/README.md: method for writing down a brand's voice (personality, tone by channel, do and don't, ban list, test)
- toolkits/02-brand-voice/worksheet.md: fill-in worksheet
- toolkits/02-brand-voice/presets.md: 12 archetypes, 24 traits, 13 channel defaults, 21 rules, 9 ban list packs, 10 test prompts
- toolkits/02-brand-voice/presets.json: the same presets, machine-readable
- toolkits/02-brand-voice/sources.md: sources for every claim
- toolkits/01-what-is-a-brand/README.md: Brand DNA Scorecard (workbook on mavic.ai)
- toolkits/06-content-calendar/README.md: 30-Day Content Calendar (workbook on mavic.ai)
- toolkits/_build/: scripts that generate the workbooks and export the presets

## Workbenches
- workbenches/README.md: how workbenches work
- workbenches/brand-dna/brand-book.md: brand book template read by the skills
- workbenches/examples/kopi-corner/brand-book.md: a complete brand book for a fictional coffee shop
- workbenches/examples/bloom-skin/brand-dna.md: Brand DNA for a fictional skincare brand

## Skills
- skills/README.md: how to install
- skills/brand-voice-check/SKILL.md: check a draft against a brand book
- skills/brand-voice-check/evals/evals.json: 8 test cases on Kopi Corner

## Video
- video/formats/explainer.md: how to make an explainer (history to first principle)
- video/formats/how-to.md: how to make a how-to (teaching layer, real recordings)
- video/capture/ep1b-screen-recording-brief.md: a full screen recording brief, with seed data and shot list
- video/remotion/paper-explainer/: Remotion source for a paper-collage explainer
- video/examples/mavic/: real episode packs (scripts, voiceover tables, captions, stills)
